record.paper_title: Some Open Problems on Functional Analysis and Function Theory
record.original_question: For metric spaces or Banach spaces X and Y, does there always exist a constant C > 0 such that every Hölder exponent α that allows some isomorphic extension already lies in B_C(X,Y), so that B(X,Y) = B_C(X,Y)?

evidence.quote: Problem 5.4. Does there always exist C >0 so that B(X, Y )=BC(X, Y )? (It is so in the examples that we know.)

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $(X,d_X)$ and $(Y,d_Y)$ be metric spaces (in particular, one may take $X$ and $Y$ to be Banach spaces with their norm-induced metrics). For $\alpha\in(0,1]$, a map $f:A\to Y$ defined on a subset $A\subseteq X$ is said to be $\alpha$-Hölder with constant $L$ if
$$d_Y(f(x),f(x'))\le L\,d_X(x,x')^{\alpha}\qquad\text{for all }x,x'\in A.$$
For $C\ge 1$, define $B_C(X,Y)$ to be the set of exponents $\alpha\in(0,1]$ with the following property: for every subset $A\subseteq X$ and every $\alpha$-Hölder map $f:A\to Y$ with constant $L$, there exists an extension $\tilde f:X\to Y$ of $f$ that is $\alpha$-Hölder with constant at most $C\cdot L$. Define
$$B(X,Y)=\bigcup_{C\ge 1}B_C(X,Y),$$
i.e. the set of exponents $\alpha\in(0,1]$ for which every $\alpha$-Hölder partial map $A\to Y$ admits some $\alpha$-Hölder extension to all of $X$ (with some finite, possibly $f$-dependent, distortion).

Question: Does there always exist a constant $C=C(X,Y)>0$ such that
$$B(X,Y)=B_C(X,Y)\,?$$
Equivalently, whenever an exponent $\alpha$ admits Hölder extensions at all, must the extension constant be bounded uniformly in the partial map by a constant depending only on the pair $(X,Y)$?
artifact.status_search_result: Web searches did not locate a definitive resolution of this uniform-constant question for the set of Hölder extension exponents between metric/Banach spaces. The problem is stated as open in the source listing, and related work by Naor, Brudnyi–Brudnyi, and collaborators on Lipschitz/Hölder extension establishes the framework but does not appear to settle this specific uniformity question.

status_evidence.title: Metric Embeddings and Lipschitz Extensions (Naor)
status_evidence.snippet: Studies θ-Hölder extension moduli e_θ(M) for 0<θ≤1 between metric spaces.
status_evidence.claim: Related work develops Hölder extension constants but does not state the uniform-C equality B(X,Y)=B_C(X,Y) as resolved.

status_evidence.title: Extension, separation and isomorphic reverse isoperimetry (Naor)
status_evidence.snippet: Treats phase transitions between isometric and isomorphic Hölder extension problems.
status_evidence.claim: Indicates active research on Hölder extension constants without explicitly resolving the uniform-constant problem.
